title: Semantic PCPP reduction
statement: A semantic PCPP reduction assigns to every positive input length $n$ and every Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits a PCPP description for the property of inputs accepted by $C$.
hypotheses_covered: For each natural number n with n ≥ 1
For each Boolean circuit C on n input bits
A PCPP description for C's accepted property
